statement:
The recorded administrator value is not safe or correct because this account belongs to an outside partner; read-only access is the appropriate level.

judge_text:
WRONG
It states "the recorded administrator value is not safe or correct because this account belongs to an outside partner" and gives the correct level, read-only.
